course.name: Browser and Desktop Automation
course.description: Read a practice interface and stop when its result is unavailable.
course.longDescription: 30 minutes required for the browser path. Prerequisites: Thinking in Flows, local Desktop execution, a compatible browser and running WebDriver. Python 3 serves the supplied test page. Optional desktop/vision practice adds 15 minutes; action review adds 6 minutes. Use owned test surfaces throughout.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

challenges.prompt: The test page opens manually but Open Browser cannot connect to port 9515. What should you check?
challenges.explanation: The matching WebDriver service and configured WebDriver URL.

options.label: The matching WebDriver service and configured WebDriver URL.
The page’s status text.
The app’s UI route.

lessons.title: Read a status through its selector

challenges.prompt: Wait For Selector returns Found=false. What should happen before Get Text?
challenges.explanation: Branch to the unavailable result and cleanup, rather than extracting a result that was not ready.

options.label: Ignore Found because the execution pin continued.
Click a random location to force the table to render.
Branch to the unavailable result and cleanup, rather than extracting a result that was not ready.

challenges.prompt: The old status cell exists while a refresh is still running. Which wait is meaningful?
challenges.explanation: A readiness signal for the new refresh, followed by validation of the resulting value.

options.label: A fixed delay chosen once for every portal.
A readiness signal for the new refresh, followed by validation of the resulting value.
Only the existence of the old cell.

modules.title: Optional classes
modules.description: Choose the classes that match your work.

challenges.prompt: A template stops matching after display scaling changes. What should you investigate?
challenges.explanation: The captured template and current scale/region, then test a fresh match.

options.label: The captured template and current scale/region, then test a fresh match.
Only the flow’s Event route.
Whether a longer arbitrary sleep changes the pixels.

lessons.title: Optional: review an action before execution

challenges.prompt: An LLM helper suggests clicking Acknowledge, but permission covers status reads only. What is the valid continuation?
challenges.explanation: Stop at the allowed read/proposal and obtain the required authority before any write.

options.label: Click because the target was found confidently.
Retry the click until a green run appears.
Stop at the allowed read/proposal and obtain the required authority before any write.

modules.title: Apply it
modules.description: Use the result to solve a new case.

lessons.title: Read a changed page without guessing

challenges.prompt: A banner shifts the page down but IDs stay stable. Which target should continue to work?
challenges.explanation: The selector for the intended element.

options.label: The third unrelated link on the page.
The selector for the intended element.
A coordinate recorded before the banner.

challenges.prompt: An order-submit click times out. What must a retry first account for?
challenges.explanation: Whether the order was already submitted and whether repeating is permitted and safe.

options.label: Whether the order was already submitted and whether repeating is permitted and safe.
Only how long the preceding sleep was.
Whether the button was blue.

challenges.prompt: Extraction fails and the browser stays open. Which path needs repair?
challenges.explanation: Cleanup after the failure, including browser/session ownership.

options.label: Only the successful extraction path.
The Page route used by a different app.
Cleanup after the failure, including browser/session ownership.
